required_input_schema.gadget_graphs: typed vertices, edges, boundaries, and logical-port labels for all five families
required_input_schema.resource_accounting: common qubit, check, round, and distance conventions
required_input_schema.validation_instances: small exact instances with expected invariant checks

forbidden_substitutions: guessed circuits, schedules, layouts, or benchmark metadata
acceptance_boundary: Construct each gadget family from typed graph inputs and derive every resource row; schematic pixels and printed output cells are forbidden inputs.
